name: Kiba
tagline: Otemachi in 10 minutes and Tokyo in 16 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000.
summary: The station is in Koto City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 10 minutes to Otemachi, 30 minutes to Shinjuku, 34 minutes to Shibuya and 30 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. The station stands -0.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.7 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at -0.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -0.3 m to 2.4 m, a difference of 2.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 8 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 3 clinics and 3 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 修世会木場病院, about 4 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 青藍会鈴木病院, about 15 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Tozai Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Tozai Line runs at 160% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 木場→門前仲町, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. schools and parks within walking distance pushes the figure up. On the other side, a large projected flood depth and only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Toyocho is ahead on how easy the shopping is, but Kiba is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kiba. It is served by the same lines as Kiba. To Tokyo, for instance, Toyocho takes 3 minutes longer. A one-room flat costs about ¥10,000 less at Toyocho. On the number of places to eat out, Toyocho comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Monzen-Nakacho is ahead on the number of lines, but Kiba is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Kiba in a straight line. Monzen-Nakacho also has the Toei Oedo Line, which Kiba does not. With more lines, Monzen-Nakacho is the better connected of the two. To Roppongi, for instance, Monzen-Nakacho is 8 minutes quicker. On quiet, though, Kiba comes out ahead.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: The 首都高速9号深川線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
永代通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 8 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Tozai Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
